target_customer: Hardware, embedded and energy systems engineering teams that test and operate devices
problem: Hardware teams export, align and script telemetry, logs and test runs by hand across many protocols.
business_model: Software platform with a free desktop app and paid cloud collaboration, SDK for Python, Rust and Go
product_category: Hardware telemetry and test data platform

founders.name: Michael Jaradah
founders.background_notes: Embedded systems, networking, safety systems and validation per YC bio.

founders.name: Taylor Keairns
founders.background_notes: Systems programming for embedded Linux and RTOS per YC bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting many industrial protocols (CAN, Modbus, OPC UA, EtherCAT), time synchronization and remote command execution requires deep embedded and systems skills.

defensibility.rationale: Protocol coverage and integration into test workflows create switching costs, and founder domain depth is hard to match; no data moat is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy reported; Foxglove (robotics, founded 2021 per directories) is an adjacent tool.

market_need_then: Not independently documented at the batch; the YC description cites siloed data between engineering, operations and quality teams.

brand_strength.rationale: No coverage of the brand itself; the Zelos name collides with several unrelated trademarks and with Zalos AI.

outcome_analysis: Zelos Cloud is an active three person company whose product is a free desktop app plus cloud workspace for hardware telemetry. No outside round, customer names or exit could be verified, so its stage is unknown rather than failed. The founders' Tesla Energy firmware background fits the hard technical niche, but traction is not public.
notes: VCBacked and CB Insights list about $500K from YC (dated Sep 2023 or Jan 2023, conflicting); aggregator only, unverified, not recorded as a round. The website names YC and Human Capital as backers by logo only. A $3.6M 2026 seed belongs to Zalos AI, a different company. No dated 2023 competitor found; Foxglove is only a loosely adjacent tool. Completeness pass: the about 500K round from YC rests on aggregators (VCBacked, CB Insights) that conflict on date (2023-01 or 2023-09), so only the year is recorded.
